cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Jamii Afya is an offline clinical decision-support advisor for community health workers in rural African clinics. Its design is driven by primary-care clinical workflows (WHO/IMCI triage, danger-sign escalation, essential-medicines dosing) and by bilingual English/Kiswahili patient communication, so the medical discipline is load-bearing on both the knowledge base and the safety behaviour.

test_prompts.prompt: Mtoto wa miaka miwili ana joto la nyuzi 39 Celsius na kikohozi kikavu, na anapumua haraka. Kama mhudumu wa afya kijijini, nifanye tathmini na hatua gani za kwanza?

A pregnant woman at 30 weeks presents with severe headache, blurred vision, and swelling of the face. What danger signs should I check for and what should I do in a rural clinic without a doctor on site?
